# Foldnote

Foldnote is a visual note-taking app for iPhone built for both personal organization and shared spaces.

## Summary

Foldnote combines structured blocks, folders, stickers, reminders, and group sharing in a warm, visual interface. It is designed for everyday planning, lightweight collaboration, and recurring life organization tasks such as routines, travel plans, checklists, recipes, study notes, and shared household coordination.

## Product facts

- Name: Foldnote
- Company: Ruzname Labs
- Website: https://foldnote.app/
- Contact: info@foldnote.app
- Platform: iPhone
- Product type: Note-taking app
- Core interface: Blocks, folders, stickers, paper styles, shared spaces

## Key capabilities

- Create notes with text, checklists, tables, links, images, and specialized blocks
- Organize information with folders, paper styles, colors, and stickers
- Share notes and folders in group spaces
- Use reminders and search to stay on top of plans and details
- Support workflows like travel planning, routines, fitness, meal prep, study, and budgeting

## Pricing summary

- Free plan available
- Yearly plan: USD 19.99
- Yearly plan includes a 2-week free trial
